dedupe_keys.name: xeneta ocean and air freight rate benchmarking data

description: Xeneta is a commercial platform for ocean and air freight rate benchmarking and market analytics. Its homepage states that it benchmarks contracted and spot rates by lane using shipper and forwarder data, lets users evaluate carriers on cost and reliability, flags outliers and overpriced trades, and centralises rates across teams through an integrated rate management system, with AI agents that surface opportunities and risks. It is used by shippers, forwarders, carriers and airlines. Coverage: global ocean and air freight lanes. Format and access: a subscription web platform. Licence and cost: paid, under commercial terms; no open data are offered on the homepage. Caveats: the homepage is marketing material without a data dictionary, and details of coverage and method need the provider's documentation. Rate and reliability series support capacity planning and resilience studies of freight networks, where rate spikes and service falls mark disruption. It complements the Freightos Baltic Index and the Drewry World Container Index in the catalogue, which publish headline indices.
